why: Four of the twelve results are famous-name pages about something else entirely (Christmas lights, storm kits, bike lights, crank radios). The rest are affiliate listicles on small or recycled domains recycling the same EBL 1300mAh Amazon listing, with generic NiMH advice and no testing anyone can check; two are India-focused or pure how-to-choose guides. No major reviewer or authority has tested rechargeable AAs in solar lights. A focused page comparing named cells on measured capacity, low-self-discharge behaviour and current prices, with a direct pick, would stand out as it did on the solar generator question.
